text:
Aisha (CS): Heads up - preflight for BlueHarbor workshop tomorrow. Need to lock microagenda, confirm SME slots, and set up feedback capture. Renewal signal on this account so want tight follow-up.

Ravi (CSE): I can cover Dedicated migration + perf tips. Which timezone block are we using? PT or ET?

Aisha (CS): Thanks. Customer prefers 10am PT. That fits internal SME windows.

Tom (Product): I can do 15 min on model selection + cost tradeoffs. Will prep 3 slides and a couple of quick examples.

Lena (Enablement): I'll own the enablement flow and the feedback form. Planning a 60-min workshop + 15-min optional office hours after. Draft microagenda below - thoughts?

Lena (Enablement): 00:00-05:00 - Quick welcome + objectives (Aisha)
05:00-20:00 - BlueHarbor use case + current infra (customer + Ravi)
20:00-35:00 - Dedicated migration patterns + batching tips (Ravi)
35:00-50:00 - Model selection & cost/quality tradeoffs (Tom)
50:00-60:00 - Action items + next steps (Aisha + Lena)
60:00-75:00 - Optional office hours (SMEs drop-in)

Ravi (CSE): LGTM. Suggest we cut model selection to 10 mins and add a 5-min live demo of KV cache warmup - that usually lands well.

Tom (Product): Fine with that. I'll condense slides into 10 mins and add 2 bullet demo script lines.

Aisha (CS): Can someone draft the calendar invite text? Need to include Zoom + pre-read + feedback form link. I'll ping the customer with pre-reads by EOD.

Lena (Enablement): Draft invite blurb done, please copy: "Join our BlueHarbor Enablement: we’ll review migration patterns, cost/quality tradeoffs, and a short demo. Please review the pre-read before the session: <https://drive.redwood/blueharbor-pre-read>. We'll send a 2-min feedback form after."

Aisha (CS): perfect. Also want to capture post-session health signal. Lena - can you add a renewal-risk checkbox in the form and a quick NPS + one friction question?

Lena (Enablement): Yep - form fields: single-choice NPS (0-10), top friction (text), renewal-risk tickbox (yes/no), follow-up owner (dropdown). I'll attach responses to the account in Salesforce.

Aisha (CS): ops-bot can you create the calendar block 10:00 PT tomorrow and attach Zoom + invite text? :pray: 

ops-bot: Created event "BlueHarbor Enablement - microagenda" // 10:00 PT tomorrow // Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123-456-789 // Calendar event ID: CA_1745550001. Invite sent to attendees list. :white_check_mark:

Ravi (CSE): Quick ask - who owns the office-hours rota after the session in case they have follow-ups? I can do the first 30 mins, then hand off to Tom.

Tom (Product): Yup I'll take the second half. If any deep infra questions, loop in infra-eng.

Aisha (CS): OK owners set. Lena - final step: add feedback form link to the invite and create a short Slack follow-up message template for customers who mark renewal-risk = yes. I'll post that in #customer-success after the session.

Lena (Enablement): Done. Form link: https://forms.redwood/blueharbor-feedback. Slack follow-up template drafted - short, empathetic, asks to schedule dedicated follow-up.

Aisha (CS): tiny poll to confirm SMEs can join office-hours: react with :one: if you can do the full 30, :two: if 15 mins only.

Ravi (CSE): :one:

Tom (Product): :two:

Lena (Enablement): :one:

Aisha (CS): Great - thanks team. I'll send pre-read + invite now and confirm with BlueHarbor.
